purpose: Pair the per-source surface patches (PHD-SURFACE-PATCH-RG-v1) by XY column (2.5D): per 0.5 m XY cell the top surface of each source is paired (and, where a source shows a second surface more than layer_gap_m below, the bottom surfaces form a second pair). Vertical patches (tilt > wall_tilt_deg) are excluded from the columns and paired by 3D proximity instead. The pair state is a DESCRIPTIVE height-offset class (compatible / prior above / current above / prior only / current only), not a source or change verdict. [injection bench V6: mvs_noise_patches (H_M_noisy); inputs are the perturbed partition copies under phase-payloads/phd/injection_bench_v1/PHD-INJECTION-BENCH-v1/V6; the relation map is the frozen original]

algorithm.name: XY_COLUMN_TOP_BOTTOM_PAIRING_WITH_WALL_EXCEPTION_v1
algorithm.semantics: For each XY cell and source, every patch present with >= min_points_per_cell_patch points gets its median z in the cell; the TOP surface is the patch with the highest median, the BOTTOM surface the lowest (a second layer only if TOP - BOTTOM > layer_gap_m). Pairs are formed per cell: TOP-TOP always; BOTTOM-BOTTOM when both sources have a second layer. dz = z_prior - z_current. State: COMPATIBLE if |dz| <= same_surface_tolerance_m; PRIOR_ABOVE if dz > tol; CURRENT_ABOVE if dz < -tol; PRIOR_ONLY / CURRENT_ONLY when one source has no patch in the cell. Cells whose paired patches include a Euclidean cluster are additionally flagged ROUGH. Planar patches with tilt > wall_tilt_deg are walls: they do not enter the columns; a wall is WALL_PAIRED to the partner patch (steeper than wall_partner_min_tilt_deg, or a scattered cluster; never a near-horizontal ground/roof patch) that holds >= wall_pair_min_fraction of its points within wall_pair_distance_m, else WALL_CURRENT_ONLY (and symmetrically for ALS walls). Patch pairs aggregate cells (>= min_cells_per_patch_pair) with median dz and MAD.
algorithm.provenance: cell 0.5 m = 2 x MVS/ALS working spacing so ALS keeps ~5 points per cell; tolerance 0.3 m = 2 x point-to-plane residual of the patch stage; layer gap 1.0 m = M3C2 projection radius; wall 70 deg and 1.0 m = surface_patch_v1 / M3C2 radius conventions
